# downsocial Instagram Video Downloader
> Free online tool to download Instagram Videos, Reels, Stories, IGTV, Carousels, and Audio clips in HD MP4, JPG, and MP3 without watermarks or login.

## Canonical URL
- https://downsocial.net/instagram-downloader/

## Documentation & Full Information
- Full specification: https://downsocial.net/instagram-downloader/llms-full.txt
- Terms of Service: https://downsocial.net/instagram-downloader/terms.html
- Privacy Policy: https://downsocial.net/instagram-downloader/privacy.html
- About Service: https://downsocial.net/instagram-downloader/about.html

## Key Capabilities
- Instagram Reels Downloader with synchronized original audio
- Instagram Story Saver for active public stories (24h)
- Instagram Carousel Downloader for multi-slide photos & videos
- Instagram to MP3 Audio extraction (up to 320kbps)
- No login required, zero cookies, zero permanent server storage
- No watermarks added to downloaded files
- High speed, mobile and desktop responsive
